prompt: Ilkhanid Persian manuscript painting, Jami al-Tawarikh, Tabriz c. 1310: horizontal band composition, swirling Chinese-style cloud bands, mineral pigments on buff paper, minimal ground line, red and ochre accents, figures with Mongol-type faces.
